integrity: All four-season inverse and three-season alias identities have analytic proofs. Exact fraction-based example checks are provided as separate reproducible files; historical or external scientific certification is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Population-law identifiability for stationary homogeneous two-state occupancy with independent season-specific binary errors satisfying 0<f_t<d_t<1, nonzero temporal memory and four seasons; does not assert finite-sample stability, nonstationary identification, or independent novelty validation.
title: Four single-visit seasons sharply identify changing false-positive occupancy
